curriculum.lesson_evidence: Social and digital texts have affordances (likes, shares, comments, ephemeral stories). Feeds may be algorithmic; context collapse means different audiences see the same post. Read producer, purpose and possible wider audience.
curriculum.scope_limit: Proposed Stage 4 NESA English alignment using catalogue outcome codes (EN4-*); content-point mapping and independent NESA verification remain pending.

lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
Explain one affordance and one context-collapse risk for a class example post (invented school-safe).

FEEDBACK

Assuming private means permanently private online. Spreads happen.

INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
Analyse two digital texts for affordances, likely audiences and collapse risks.

Write a short reflection describing one specific revision you made and why.
